description: Internal source documents for AI-assisted doc generation. Not published on the docs site.

googleDocs.title: Copy of CMP Admin Documentation - CHATGPT
googleDocs.notes: Master CMP admin documentation source. Prefer this when drafting or updating any docs/ page.

googleDocs.title: Features List - Documentation is Required
googleDocs.notes: Feature inventory and documentation requirements. Use alongside the primary doc for gaps, VPC/network ACL behaviour, and per-feature doc scope.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Payment Gateways tab
googleDocs.notes: Payment gateway configuration details for Stripe, AsiaPay, HyperPay, Authorize.net, M-Pesa, PayPal, Razorpay, Mollie, Dinger, Cardlink, Paytm, Payduniya. Prefer when expanding docs/billing/payment-gateways/ pages.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Change Rate Card Feature (Beta)
googleDocs.notes: Change Rate Card beta: assign at admin onboarding, default on self-reg, change only if no services; resellers no change (replicated DB). Roadmap: change any time, bulk update, replicate with all features. Prefer for docs/billing/rate-cards/.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — CMP API Access tab
googleDocs.notes: CMP API Access: Admin/User API enablement, generate token, Bearer auth, role permissions (Billing Setup + Profile), subuser assignment, integration token notes. Prefer when updating docs/platform-features/apis.md.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Isolated Networks tab
googleDocs.notes: Isolated networks: ACS VR model, DefaultIsolatedNetworkOfferingWithSourceNatService, multi-offering sync, enable_network_billing, Source NAT reuse, last-VM network cleanup, end-user packages. Prefer when updating docs/orchestrator-features/cloudstack/networks/isolated-network.md.

googleDocs.title: VPC Network + Network ACL host-level investigation
googleDocs.notes: Support/investigation notes: VPC ACL is tier-scoped; createNetworkACL has single cidrlist (source for ingress, destination for egress); no dual source+destination host fields in ACS 4.20 API. Host-level dual-end ACL needs ACS enhancement; CMP UI should clarify Direction/Source/Destination. Used for docs/orchestrator-features/cloudstack/networks/vpc-network.md ACL section. Cross-check ACS https://docs.cloudstack.apache.org/en/latest/adminguide/networking/virtual_private_cloud_config.html and createNetworkACL API.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Invoice Number Setting
googleDocs.notes: Invoice number format, padding, auto reset, FY start month, series A→Z→AA, max per series, sample configs. Prefer for docs/billing/invoice-settings/invoice-number.md.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Branches / Multi-Branch Management
googleDocs.notes: Multi-branch: why branches, default branch for unmatched countries, Create Branch fields, invoice settings, country-level taxation only. Prefer for docs/billing/invoice-settings/.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Disciplinary Actions (tab t.0)
googleDocs.notes: Freeze / Suspend / Terminate: triggers (prepaid negative vs postpaid overdue), grace reminders, resource effects, invoicing, stoppable billing under suspension, admin revoke/exclude, email templates. Prefer for docs/billing/disciplinary-actions/.

googleDocs.title: Ceph Object Storage Configuration Guide
googleDocs.notes: CEPH object storage: Cloud Provider wizard (API + S3 endpoints, zone, storage settings), rate card quotas, user ops (create/overview/credentials/resize), bucket/object features. Prefer for docs/orchestrators/ceph/ and docs/orchestrator-features/ceph/.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — CEPH / Object Storage features tab
googleDocs.notes: CEPH orchestrator features inventory in CMP Admin Documentation. Prefer alongside ceph-object-storage cache when expanding docs/orchestrator-features/ceph/. Google Drive MCP may be required to refresh this tab.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Bandwidth billing tab
googleDocs.notes: Bandwidth CloudStack: listUsageRecords type 4 SENT, network/VPC flags. OpenStack bandwidth is documented separately at docs/orchestrator-features/openstack/bandwidth.md (Gnocchi VM-level).

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Low Infra Credit Notification tab
googleDocs.notes: Prepaid-only low infra credit alerts: Profile → Notifications, threshold, hourly check, one email per day. Prefer for docs/billing/low-infra-credit-notifications.md.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Import Existing VMs / Sync Resources tab
googleDocs.notes: CloudStack Import VM / sync resources: use cases, domain hierarchy, account/project mapping, import form fields, limitations, FAQ. Prefer for docs/orchestrator-features/cloudstack/sync-resources.md. Documentation still expanding.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Selling Non-Automated Services / Products tab
googleDocs.notes: Baseline Products/Store: add-ons vs products, hybrid, categories, add product, billing, orders, customer workflow, FIXED_PRORATA examples. Prefer alongside store-products-enhanced for docs/platform-features/store/.

googleDocs.title: Features List — Products (Standalone Services) enhanced
googleDocs.notes: Enhanced Products: SKU, vendor, tags, additional fees, lifecycle statuses (Draft/Active/…/Internal Only), business rules. Prefer for docs/platform-features/store/add-products.md.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Marketplace Apps tab
googleDocs.notes: Marketplace Apps: pre-installed images, environment variables, startup script size (vm.userdata.max.length vs max_startup_script_size_in_bytes), automation limitations and recommended approaches. Prefer for docs/platform-features/marketplace-apps/.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Multi-language tab
googleDocs.notes: Multi-language: enablement via StackConsole, end-user portal only, translation coverage/limitations, email templates, system alerts, profile App Language, supported languages, deprecated browser-cache selection. Prefer for docs/platform-features/multi-language.md.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Terms and Conditions tab
googleDocs.notes: Terms and Conditions: one-liner (terms_conditions_one_liner), in-step registration form with branch placeholders, enforce_terms_condition. Prefer for docs/platform-features/terms-and-conditions/.

googleDocs.title: Google reCAPTCHA v2 Checkbox Setup Guide (user-provided)
googleDocs.notes: CAPTCHA: Google reCAPTCHA v2 Checkbox only (not v3/Invisible); CMP path Settings → System → Captcha Settings (GOOGLE Site Key / Secret Key / Active / Mark as Default). Cloudflare CAPTCHA also supported via same settings. Prefer for docs/platform-features/captcha/.

googleDocs.title: Veeam Stack Console Setup Doc
googleDocs.notes: Veeam VSPC: access requirements, API key (9.1), public URLs, add provider, packages, unit pricing, quotas. Prefer for docs/orchestrators/veeam/ and docs/installation/orchestrator-requirements/veeam.md. Distinct from CloudStack native Veeam B&R plugin.

googleDocs.title: CloudStack Kubernetes (4.20+ / CMP 4.21.0) — user briefing + screenshots
googleDocs.notes: New K8s model: separate Master/Control vs Worker packages; compute offering CPU+memory only (no root disk); no custom plans; shared volume plan; resource-based billing (cluster not charged; per-node VM, volume, IP/LB/network in progress); sync only when parent Running; change plan at cluster level; CSI option no separate billing yet; templates per role not in CMP. Prefer for docs/orchestrators/cloudstack/offering-sync-and-packages/kubernetes.md and docs/orchestrator-features/cloudstack/kubernetes/.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Kubernetes user guide / Access documents (Documentation Config)
googleDocs.notes: Admin Documentation Config on Settings → Orchestrator → Kubernetes Version. Edit/Preview, placeholders {{kubeconfigPath}} {{kubernetesVersion}}, sections/steps/blocks (paragraph, code, code block, single link, link list, command template, labeled commands, inline mixed). Available May 13, 2026. Prefer for docs/orchestrator-features/cloudstack/kubernetes/access-documents.md.

googleDocs.title: CMP Admin Documentation — Kubernetes create/ops (legacy tab; ops only, not old billing)
googleDocs.notes: Legacy K8s ops: create params, example provisioning, VMs, isolated network+SNAT+default LB, firewall SSH, PF 22/2222+, autoscaling sync, upgrade, min 2 CPU, predefined vs custom. Do NOT use old billing (free control node, IP/LB included in cluster package, single plan for all nodes). Prefer new resource-based billing + separate master/worker packages. Merged into docs/orchestrator-features/cloudstack/kubernetes/ and packages kubernetes.md.
